notes:
Task: T-010, repository web URL from the git origin remote (tickets/T-010-repo-url-from-origin.md, part of this diff; issue https://github.com/UBayouski/tracenotes/issues/25). New: src/remote.ts repoUrlFromRemote(remote) (pure), exported from src/index.ts; src/cli.ts render gets --origin, CliIo.readOrigin (default execFileSync git remote get-url origin, no shell). Tests: tests/remote.test.ts (new), tests/cli.test.ts (injected-reader block and child-process block in throwaway repos under os.tmpdir with GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES). README and BACKLOG updated.

Project rules (AGENTS.md): 1 No Orphan Notes, 2 Nothing Vanishes, 4 zero runtime dependencies, 5 tests never touch the network or the live repository (git may run only in throwaway repos), 6 Validate Before You Normalize (only documented framing removed before validation; here: one trailing \n or \r\n, one .git suffix, userinfo), 7 no raw invisible characters in .ts. Convention: src/cli.ts is the only src module touching process streams; CLI argument changes need child-process cases in tests/cli.test.ts.

Unchanged constraints: checkRepoUrl() in src/render.ts accepts exactly https://<host>[:port]/<owner>/<repo>, port 1-65535, no .git, no trailing slash; renderMarkdown/renderJson call it again via notesDocument(). repoUrlFromRemote always ends with checkRepoUrl().

Security intent: a remote may contain credentials (https://user:token@host/...). They must never appear in stdout, in the notes, or in any error message; therefore error messages never quote the remote or git's stderr.

Checks run: npm run check (tsc --noEmit + node --test) passes, 279 tests, 0 failures (227 before). Manual run on the real repository: git log -3 ... | node src/cli.ts render --origin printed links to https://github.com/UBayouski/tracenotes. Not tested: Linux (CI runs it on PR), a git build that prints remotes in a non-UTF-8 encoding, insteadOf rewriting.
decisions: Human (Nov 16): --origin is opt-in. Without it output is unchanged and git is never run; --origin with --repo-url is a usage error.
Human (Nov 16): credentials in the remote are dropped, never echoed, rather than refused (refusing would break CI checkouts that embed a token).

Agent: accepted forms are https, ssh:// and scp-like only; http, git://, file:// and local paths are rejected; the SSH port is dropped, the https port kept; exactly two path segments (nested groups out of scope); . and .. segments rejected.
Agent: errors from repoUrlFromRemote use a fixed message listing the accepted forms; a failed git read prints one fixed line, never git's output.
Agent: the origin is read after option and config checks and after the terminal check, immediately before stdin is read.
recent_work: First review of this branch: whole T-010 change is new behavior (ticket, src/remote.ts, --origin in src/cli.ts, tests, README, BACKLOG).
